description: Paid ($0.001/call): Run a decision's plan (decisionId from POST /api/decide), or a free plan sketch (steps), through Agent402: first-party steps run directly, third-party steps are bought from the seller and resold to you at Agent402's price (paid with a wallet on Base; prepaid credits and cards do not pay this route).

maxBudgetUsd.description: Spend ceiling for the run (default: the plan's estimate via Agent402)

params.description: Per-step params overriding the plan's exampleParams, keyed by step number

replan.description: With decisionId: plan the saved task again on current prices and reliability, then run the new plan. Adds the plan price for that decision's depth to the quote; the answer's replanned field lists what changed. Default false.

steps.description: Instead of decisionId: the tool slugs of a free plan sketch (from /api/find or /api/route), 2 to 5, in order. Pass params for step 1; a later step takes its one required input from the step before.

name: decide.execute
title: Decide: execute a plan
